topic: remove salt stains from leather boots
core_question: How do I get white salt/rock-salt stains off leather boots in winter?
answer_summary: Mix equal parts white vinegar and water, wipe the salt-stained areas with a cloth dampened in the solution, then wipe with a clean damp cloth and let dry before conditioning.
